title: Prescription discount program
summary: Explains Rho’s Prescription discount program: using your Rho debit card at participating pharmacies applies a 12.5% discount at checkout. It covers how to use the card, how to confirm participating locations in the app, and what to do if the discount doesn’t show on the receipt.
faqs: How do I get the 12.5% prescription discount at checkout?
Where can I find participating pharmacies so the discount is applied?
Do I need to ask the pharmacist to process the discount?
What should I do if the discount doesn’t appear on my receipt?
Should I use the same Rho debit card for refills to get the discount?
What happens if I’m prompted to process the discount at the pharmacy counter?
